name: Hy4 measured on AA Index, APEX-Agents, and Agent Arena
title: Hy4 measured on AA Index, APEX-Agents, and Agent Arena
summary: Artificial Analysis measured Tencent Hy4 at 35 on Intelligence Index v5, level with Grok 4.7 (xhigh), with 31 percent on FrontierCode 2.0 and a 1 million token context window. Mercor then ranked it first on APEX-Agents at 77.6 percent Pass@1 among models it calls open-weights, and Arena ranked it the top Chinese model on Agent Arena.

appearances.title: Artificial Analysis scores Hy4 on Intelligence Index v5
appearances.summary: Artificial Analysis scored Tencent Hy4 at 35 on Intelligence Index v5, level with Grok 4.7 and one point behind Claude Haiku 5.5, and second among models from China-based labs behind Kimi K3.1 Pro at 46. Hy4 scored 31 percent on FrontierCode 2.0, takes text and image input, and has a 1 million token context window.
